name: babysit-pr
description: One iteration of PR babysitting, built to run in a loop: checks PR state, addresses reviewer feedback and failing CI as the PR author, pushes, and ends the loop when every thread is resolved and every check has passed. Invoke with $babysit-pr. User-invoked only.
